original_answer.example_en: I'm short on sleep after working late all week.
original_answer.example_zh: 这周一直加班到很晚，我现在睡眠不足。
original_answer.usage_note: be short on sleep表示睡眠不足；short on表示某物不够。

revised_answer.example_en: I'm short on sleep after working late all week.
revised_answer.example_zh: 这周一直加班到很晚，我现在睡眠不足。
revised_answer.usage_note: be short on sleep表示睡眠不足；short on表示某物不够。

rows.cg_qa_reason: be short on sleep表达睡眠不足，seriously short on sleep搭配自然；例句译文准确。

original_answer.example_en: I missed the alarm because my phone was on silent.
original_answer.example_zh: 手机设成静音，我没听到闹钟提醒。
original_answer.usage_note: miss the alarm在此指未听见或未注意到提醒；不表示错过预约。

revised_answer.example_en: I didn't hear my alarm this morning and overslept.
revised_answer.example_zh: 今天早上我没听到闹钟，结果睡过头了。
revised_answer.usage_note: miss the alarm表示没有听到或注意到闹钟提醒；更常说not hear your alarm或sleep through your alarm。手机静音模式不一定影响闹钟。

rows.cg_qa_reason: 原句手机静音未必影响闹钟已纠正；新版didn't hear my alarm自然但没有示范目标miss the alarm，建议补I missed my alarm and overslept，或将主目标改sleep through my alarm并经身份审批。

original_answer.example_en: I opened the curtains to let in the morning sun.
original_answer.example_zh: 我拉开窗帘，让早晨的阳光照进来。
original_answer.usage_note: draw the curtains可能表示拉上或拉开，须结合上下文；open更明确。

revised_answer.example_en: I opened the curtains to let in the morning sun.
revised_answer.example_zh: 我拉开窗帘，让早晨的阳光照进来。

original_answer.example_en: I turned on the alarm for six thirty tomorrow morning.
original_answer.example_zh: 我打开了明早六点半的闹钟。
original_answer.usage_note: turn on the alarm在手机场景中可指启用已有闹钟；设定新时间更常说set an alarm。

revised_answer.example_en: I switched my 6:30 alarm on for tomorrow morning.
revised_answer.example_zh: 我启用了明早六点半的闹钟。
revised_answer.usage_note: turn an alarm on指启用已有闹钟；set an alarm通常指设定提醒时间。

rows.cg_qa_reason: switch an alarm on解释启用已有闹钟准确，但例句未直接包含目标turn on the alarm；建议I turned on my 6:30 alarm for tomorrow morning，并保留启用与设定的区分。
